#### Characteristics Tab

The options on this tab are date effective based on the From and To dates shown.

The following options are available on the Characteristics tab:

- **Status** - Set to Active, Inactive, Long-Term Monitoring, or Plugged and Abandoned. The status is datetime effective. If the status is anything other than Active and location rollups calculates a change in inventory, an exception (20006 INV – Total changed when inventory was not active) will be generated to alert the user.
- **Capacity Table** - Indicates the active capacity table for this tank. New tickets will default to using this table for calculations.
- **Data Entry Mode** - Applies to Tank Run Tickets. Specify whether to enter open and close values for only tank levels (common for movements on field production tanks), or for all data points.
- **Volume Calc Method** - Specifies the calculation sequence used for each tank type
- **Component Calc Method** - Three options available
  - **Net Mass** - Net mass and mass fraction are used to calculate component mass which is then converted to component volume using component densities.
  - **Net Standard Volume** - Net Standard Volume and liquid volume fraction are used to calculate component volume.
  - **Follow Product** - If the product is a purity product then FLOWCAL will calculate components using Net Standard Volume and liquid volume fraction. If the product is not a purity product then FLOWCAL will use net mass and mass fraction to calculate components.
- **Run Ticket Span** - Determines how run tickets are treated during the rollup process. This option ensures that run tickets are rolled into the desired hour, day and month.
  - **Time Leads** - The run ticket's effective date represents the start time of the run (example: A run ticket movement effective 4/01/2021 @7:00 (contract hour = 7) will be rolled into the measurement day 4/01/2021)
  - **Time Trails** - The run ticket's effective date represents the end time of the run (example: A run ticket movement effective 4/01/2021 @7:00 (contract hour = 7) will be rolled into the measurement day 3/31/2021)
